source.record_title: Dataset for H2SAFE - Controlled Gas Releases and Sensor-Response for Indoor Hydrogen Safety

eligibility_recheck.reason: The current public record is the same five helium-release archive already audited. It contains concentration time series and spatial metadata but no synchronized station/controller, dispenser/nozzle and vehicle/receptacle channels; the release-to-CSV timing crosswalk remains unavailable.

claim_boundary: Public-record availability and byte-integrity recheck only. This does not create hydrogen concentration validation, detector-placement validation, outdoor dispersion, ESD, safety-distance or station-to-vehicle full-loop evidence.
